ruleConfig.name: retryable failure offers operable retry within configurable timeout
ruleConfig.description: When a retryable-failure occurs and business evidence establishes that retry is currently permitted, the retry control should become operable within the configured timeoutMs budget (observed business budget: 5000 ms). No incidental faulty UI state such as retrying-disabled is required; healthy recovery is also in scope. Intended reusable scope: retryable-failure occurrences for retry-category controls generally. Validated scope: the payment retry failure scenario only, plus an observed healthy counterexample where a retryable-failure transition reached an actionable retry control. A button label alone does not establish retry eligibility; cooldown, exhausted attempts, ongoing operations, or unmet prerequisites do not establish eligibility.
